definitions: Clean out the bed of (a harbour, river, or other area of water) with a dredge.
Bring up or clear (something) from a river, sea, or lake with a dredge.
Search for something by sifting through the contents of something else.
Sprinkle (food) with flour or another powdered ingredient.
examples: They dredged up some interesting facts.
She dredged the chicken with flour.
